name: tedtoolkit-resume
description: Resume creation, revision, review, job matching, and interview-question workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Create, tailor, review, and evaluate resumes
interface.longDescription: Factual, evidence-led workflows for creating and revising resumes, matching them to job descriptions, and generating structured interview questions.
defaultPrompt: Write or revise resume copy only when I ask for a resume artifact; use review-resume for feedback without rewriting.
Use match-job-description only for a requirement-by-requirement comparison when both candidate evidence and a job description are supplied.
For interview questions, select Interviewer or Candidate practice mode and produce a directly requested finished pack with stated defaults instead of adding another approval gate.
